rows.grounds: fused form tāram+eva+uktam; tāra as full or high measure
breadth or extent of the sides

items.question: What alternative measurement do other authorities prescribe for the side-width?
premises: Other authorities hold a different view on the side-width.
They state the side-width as the full measure.
This alternative prescription is now being reported.
items.inference: According to other authorities, the side-width is to be taken as the full measure.
uncertainties: The precise technical value of tāra in this measurement context is not fully specified.
items.plain_english: Now it is stated that others prescribe the side-width as the full measure.
